purpose: Exercise a deterministic candidate-similarity lifecycle route on two fixed anonymous predicted-Train videos without labels, training, or forced reuse.
threshold_rationale: Single pre-registered engineering margin for candidate existing-token reuse; no sweep or selection.
selection_rule: Reuse the highest-similarity existing candidate only when its numeric adapted similarity reaches the fixed margin; otherwise create NEW. Candidate bindings remain outside the scorer.
interpretation: A natural cross-video token is engineering evidence for candidate-aware lifecycle plumbing only; it is not M supervision, predicted-track training, or a scientific result.
